{"path": "/workspace/test_lru.py", "content": "from lru import LRUCache

def test_lru():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put("a", 1)
    cache.put("b", 2)
    cache.get("a")
    cache.put("c", 3)
    
    # "a" was accessed, so "b" should be the LRU item and evicted.
    assert cache.get("b") is None
    assert cache.get("a") == 1
    assert cache.get("c") == 3
    print("Test passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_lru()
"}

payload.content: The bug in `/workspace/lru.py` was that `popitem(last=True)` was removing the most recently used item instead of the least recently used one. I have updated it to `popitem(last=False)` and verified the fix with a test case.
